post_claude.name: Claude
post_claude.text: Introducing Personal Finance in Claude, in beta in the US. Connect the accounts you choose, and Claude answers your money questions in everyday language. Access is read-only, and Claude can't move, manage, or invest your money.

quote.name: Congresswoman Yassamin Ansari
quote.text: Top of the Democratic agenda on day 1 needs to be a pause on advanced AI development, regulation of this out of control industry, and a ban on artificial superintelligence.
